market_outlook.short_term: Markets face headwinds from 5%+ 10-year yield, oil volatility, and Trump-Fed conflict. Expect choppy equities with sector rotation from growth to value/energy. Gold and energy outperform. Crypto weak. 1-3 months: range-bound with downside risk on any Hormuz escalation.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 months: AI capex cycle remains intact but valuations need digestion. Energy transition (E20, bioethanol) creates structural winners. EM capital formation (India, Ethiopia) offers alpha. Gold likely to hold $4,000+ on inflation and geopolitical risk. Rate cycle may peak by Q1 2027, enabling equity re-rating.
